Revolut (revolut.com), London-founded global fintech/'superapp' (CEO Nik Storonsky). Seedcamp invested Feb 2015; seed £1.5m ($2.3m) led by Balderton (Jul 2015), extended to $4.8m total by Feb 2016. Primary equity Series A–E sums to ~$1.71B (Series E at $33B). Later 2024 ($45B) and Nov 2025 ($75B, led by Coatue/Greenoaks/Dragoneer/Fidelity) transactions were employee/secondary share sales and excluded; Crowdcube campaigns folded into the Series A figure.
